method: Four prespecified fresh-context comparisons. Current first-gesture loading, encoded-byte cache, and offline-decoded UI pack. Preparation runs in a served module script; a console readiness event is awaited before any locator evaluation. Activation state is measured before native input. Native pointer gesture; real AudioEngine and source.start; no autoplay bypass, mix changes or output normalization. Later valid output timestamps may retrospectively estimate the first source; this is not physical onset or gameplay acceptance.
